segments.text: Avam vidasya asya for this kind of yogi, katha asya paha.
Ordinary talk of life is recitation of Mantra.
He recites Mantra.
If he loves with you, embraces you, talks to you, goes with you to pictures.
This is the recitation he recites his Mantra.
This is the real recitation of Mantra for him.
The actual recitation of Mantra like this is just to exploit people.
You should not do this way.
You should do that way.
You must not be known to anybody.
For him, katha japa.
Ordinary talk of life is for him recitation of Mantra.
Because aham yavu paro hamza shiva parma karanam.
In his talk, he experiences and he is aware of that fullness of eye consciousness.
Eye God consciousness.
Is it correct?
Eye God consciousness.
Then eye consciousness of God.
Eye consciousness of God.
It is not eye consciousness, individual consciousness.
It is eye God consciousness.
Eye consciousness can be individual consciousness also, but it is not meant there.
Capital eye.
Yes.
Yes.
This is explained in such an dandra.
In this way, nityam yavu paraham bhavanam ayatat.
He is always merged.
He has always merged in that supreme eye consciousness of God.
That is it.
Devati devastya para bodusurupina yumarsya parama sakti sarvagya ganesh alini.
For him, who is one with that supreme,
boda, supreme knowledge, supreme cognitive state of Lord.
For him, parama sakti, that supreme energy is yumarsya kal, yumarsya,
and it is filled with all knowledge and shining with all knowledge.
Yich rikali kakram nirupit nitya, maha mantraath maka agar taka am yumarsya aru desil.
To him, who is established in that yumarsya,
which is not artificial vimarsya, which has come by itself,
not made spontaneous vimarsya.
For him yatyat alaapadi, whatever his daily talk is existing,
tata tata sya svaathma devata yumarsya,
unavada tawarthana atma japa vajayati,
that becomes for him japa,
recitation of real mantra of self.
Tattukham tri vikjana bairavina,
vikjana bairavantra it is also said,
buryo burya pari bhabhi bhabhana bhabhi te hiya,
that state of awareness which is established
in that God consciousness repeatedly, always.
Burya burya, greater, greater awareness.
Japa svaathra, that is in real way japa for him,
recitation of mantra.
Sayam nada, that nada of japa is there existing automatically,
and that japa, who is recited for whom,
for whom this mantra is recited,
that devata is also existing there.
This is the way.
Sakare na bairiyati, hakare na vishyatpana,
by going out, he atters sir,
by coming in, he atters sir.
In the same way, he recites the mantra of
humsa and humsa, so-hum, so-hum, so-hum.
This ajapa guy, he is always existing for him,
day and night.
Shachatani, diva ratrao, sahasraa, naikyum shiti,
21,600 times he recites this mantra of japa
with breath, day and night.
And this japa is of that supreme energy of God consciousness,
and it is very easy for those who are aware
and very difficult for those who are not aware.
This is the best we'll do today.
You know, how many years?
60 years.
21,000 times breathing one day.
21,600 times we breathe in and out, day and night.
And 21,600 days become 60 years of life.
This is full life.
60 years is called full life,
full life, full life, full life.
After 60, this I use barodil, barod from others.
It is why after 60 you don't maintain energy of that type.
Thank you.
